mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) compresses discount rates and boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE > 8.0%) signals economic distress and triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as investors flee risk.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 8.0, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates broad demand weakness, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in > 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the interaction effect's Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle contraction regime, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 98.0) signals an imminent recession, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 98.0 during late-cycle contraction, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of total employment (PAYEMS > 135,000 thousand) consistently predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as it reflects a strong labor market and rising consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in > 60% of instances when PAYEMS > 135000, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeding 3.0% triggers hawkish monetary policy expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL yoy > 3.0, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) and monthly housing starts (HOUST) signals a broad economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in > 60% of instances when both GDPC1 and HOUST decline, or the interaction effect's Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 0.5%), the S&P 500 tends to underperform, producing negative 20-day returns as higher rates compress equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 0.5, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.
